description: Rewrite the core tool-independent Methodology specifications in natural American English while preserving their normative behavior. The migration covers the overview Product structure Feature schema and Coding Rules architecture outside the detailed execution loop.
acceptance_criteria: The selected Methodology documents are written in natural American English
Product Feature schema dependency and Coding Rules requirements retain their prior semantics
Internal links and referenced paths remain valid
A rule-by-rule review finds no removed gate or weakened normative requirement
